import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold, KFold
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
ok['hour']=ok.created.dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','promised_min','hour']
X=ok[cols]
y=ok.actual_min>ok.promised_min
from time import perf_counter as seconds
X=pd.get_dummies(ok[cols+['courier','weather','shop_id']],dtype=int)
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.2,random_state=42)
models={'дерево':DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=0),'лес':RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100,random_state=0),'логрегрессия':LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)}
rows={}
for name,m in models.items():
 t0=seconds()
 m.fit(X_train,y_train)
 t1=seconds()
 pred=m.predict(X_test)
 t2=seconds()
 rows[name]={'accuracy':round(accuracy_score(y_test,pred),3),'fit_s':t1-t0,'predict_s':t2-t1}
speed=pd.DataFrame(rows).T
fit_ratio=speed.loc['лес','fit_s']/speed.loc['дерево','fit_s']
expect: Корректный алиас seconds() замеряет fit/predict реальными разностями часов; accuracyизpred, тристрокимоделей, fit_ratioлес/дерево.
